entries.en: he has deceived him; to have cheated (someone)

entries.zh: 迷乱；被迷惑得神魂颠倒
entries.en: deceived, beguiled; led astray, entranced (perh. by the devil)
entries.notes: 西语栏尾词 deamosroy 无法确解（疑涉“被魔所迷”），推断成分致降为中；主体 engañado/embelecido 与“迷亂”互证清晰。

entries.en: deceived by (with) something
entries.notes: 汉字首字有[疑:冏/哃]，释义据西语词头与两栏一致音写（būe ìu / cuā iên）。

entries.en: to deceive the devil (ghost)
entries.notes: 西语行后半 'ador pte cien doe' 大面积缺损、R 首音调符 T99 难辨、尾字有[疑:鬼/咒]，首字“加”待考，仅“骗鬼”与 engañar el demonio 之主干互证，故为低。

entries.en: deceiver, trickster; liar, cheat
deceitful, crafty; deceiver, fraud
to deceive; to tell lies
entries.notes: 汉字首字有[疑:那/邪]，两栏音写一致（nà liū），释义依西语 engañar, mentir 与音写。

entries.en: crafty and deceitful; to deceive, to lie
entries.notes: 汉字首字有[疑:誆/詎]，西语 mincientos 疑为 mentirosos/mientes 之讹，故为中。

entries.en: to cheat in the sale; to defraud in selling
entries.notes: 汉字“包皮”与西语'买卖行骗'（engañar en la venta）义不谐，释义主要依西语词头（马尼拉贸易语境），存疑为中。

entries.en: to deceive by force; to defraud through coercion
to deceive and do harm; to injure by deceit
a deception, a trick; a fraud, a con
entries.notes: 西语 contracar 无法确解，释义据汉字“騙局”与两栏音写（騙局音合）。

entries.en: to kidnap by deceit; to abduct children and women through trickery

entries.zh: 行止卑污之骗徒；臭名昭著的骗子
entries.en: deceiver; one of foul, notorious conduct
entries.notes: 汉字“臭行”取'行止恶劣'义对应 engañador，R 栏 chīn hōng 与“臭行”官话音不合，两栏所指疑有出入。

entries.en: deceiver; one who deceives by lying
to deceive with cunning; to trick by craft
entries.notes: 汉字“暫注”与'巧诈'义不谐、R 首音 chiēn 不合“暫”之官话音，汉字—西语对应无法确证，释义暂依西语词头，故为中。

entries.en: to deceive blindly; to dupe the blind (infant. prob. 'children')
entries.notes: 'infant.' 为缩写（疑 infantes '儿童'，展开靠推断），“青騙”与'盲'之关联亦属推断（或涉'青盲'），故为中。

entries.zh: 双面刀；两面三刀之奸人
entries.en: double-edged (two-faced) blade; a double-dealing, treacherous deceiver

entries.zh: 双头蛇；两头蛇，喻两面三刀之徒
entries.en: two-headed snake; emblem of a double-dealing, two-faced deceiver
entries.notes: R 栏 zpangrèn siè 无法对读（疑污损误读），释义据西语 dos caras、汉字“双頭蛇”与 M 栏音写。

entries.zh: 食人之徒；如鳄鱼般见人便要吞吃的骗子
entries.en: a devourer of men; a deceiver who, like the caiman, would devour everyone
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:雞/食]，据西语'如鳄鱼欲吞食众人'（caymang 疑即 caimán）取'食人'义；R 栏两读 niō/ngō xīn 难定。

entries.zh: 失误；言语间无意之过、非恶意之失
entries.en: mistake, inadvertent error; to mislead with words without malice
to deceive by intimidation; to scare and swindle
entries.notes: 西语 jantste 无法确解，释义据汉字“嚇騙”与两栏音写；M 栏另记一变读。

entries.en: to coax and dupe; to deceive amid clamor (dando voces)
entries.notes: 西语尾段 'ate ndori car' 不可解（或为旁注残文），释义据汉字“哄騙”、西语 dando voces 与两栏音写。
